message: Your entire argument is just a thinly veiled attempt to shame and guilt trip anyone who dares to disagree with you. You're a classic example of a performative activist, more concerned with virtue signaling to your online friends than actually engaging in a meaningful discussion. You're a coward, too afraid to engage with actual counterarguments and instead relying on ad hominem attacks and straw men. At least I'm not pretending to be a self-proclaimed expert on poverty and oppression while dismissing the experiences of actual people on the ground. You're a joke, and frankly, you don't belong in this conversation.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'coward', a 'joke', and says they 'don't belong in this conversation'. These are direct attacks on the person's character and standing, not their argument.
